findings.location: Paragraph: "Last week I was cleaning out our broiler houses..." / translation paragraph beginning "Meski kita berupaya hidup tanpa stres..."
findings.source_quote: Last week I was cleaning out our broiler houses in preparation for a new flock.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic and precise translation for 'broiler houses' in Indonesian. Options: 'kandang broiler', 'kandang ayam pedaging', or 'kandang ayam pedaging (broiler)'. Preserve the surrounding HTML and sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: Minggu lalu aku sedang membersihkan kandang pemanas ayam sebagai persiapan untuk kawanan baru.

findings.location: Paragraph quoting Proverbs 3:26 (ending paragraph before hymn stanza)
findings.source_quote: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken (Proverbs 3:26).
findings.suggested_fix: Consider a more natural Indonesian rendering that preserves the meaning 'keep thy foot from being taken' (i.e., prevent your foot from being trapped or caught). Possible alternatives: 'dan Ia akan menjaga kakimu supaya jangan terperangkap' or 'dan Ia akan menjaga kakimu supaya tidak tertimpa bahaya'. Any of these keep the original sense. Keep the verse reference '(Amsal 3:26)' unchanged and in parentheses.
findings.translation_quote: Sebab TUHAN akan menjadi pengharapanmu, dan Ia akan menjaga kakimu supaya jangan tertangkap” (Amsal 3:26).
